caseName: American Motor Specialties Co. v. Federal Trade Commission
caseNameFull: American Motor Specialties Co., Inc. v. Federal Trade Commission
attorneys: Meyer Schifrin for petitioners. Solicitor General Rankin, Assistant Attorney General Bicks, Charles H. Weston, Daniel J. McCauley, Jr. and Alan B. Hobbes for respondent. David C. Murchison and Robert L. Wald for movants.

opinions.text: The motion of Mid-South Distributors et al. for leave to defer consideration of the petition is denied. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied.
